reports.title: Repeated function-family reconstruction
reports.summary: `seg_00770000` is a code-section name, not one class. In the 2007-08 client it contains 1,062 functions, but opcode-only grouping found 38 repeated size-and-shape families covering 1,041 members. The largest families were 322 10-byte jump thunks and 275 25-byte wrappers.
